notes.title: Update 0.1.2-alpha | The demo is coming soon ❤️
notes.content:
➡️ Add TileHunter to your wishlist ❤️

Here’s an overview of the changes and improvements:

New features & content
[olist]
Steam stats and achievements: A new win tracking system has been added, along with a scoreboard to see where you stand.
New random boss system: On the 5th and 10th floors, the boss selection is now random, providing a renewed challenge with each run.
One heart per floor: In the rocky dungeon, you can find an item that adds a life point (up to a maximum of 5). It can be very important in extreme need!
A Mine floor: This floor can sometimes appear to vary the exploration. Who knows what surprises await you there?
[/olist]

Quality of life
[olist]
Continue button in the tutorial: More visible, to avoid getting stuck.
Important confirmations:
– Restart the tutorial? A confirmation request appears to prevent any accidents.
– Quit the game? Same principle: you are allowed to be sure of your choice.
Improvement of the Game Over screen: Clearer, prettier.
Improvement of the minimap: Now more readable.
[/olist]

Fixes and optimizations
[olist]
Special room: The bug has been fixed.
Bird trajectories: The movements have been adjusted for more consistent behavior.
Texture bug fix: Birds in nests will no longer cause display bugs.
Quest completed notification: A small notification appears when you complete a quest.
FX effect on the trapdoor: A small visual addition.
Opening doors: The movement logic has changed in dungeons. Now, you can move freely, as long as no monsters are present in the room or any element blocks the path. More freedom for more speed! Of course, when you can no longer move, the doors of the rooms open automatically once all monsters are defeated.
[/olist]

And above all… the demo is coming soon!

In a little while, you will be able to test TileHunter and discover the rocky dungeon, its enemies, and its treasures. Stay tuned, and don’t forget to add TileHunter to your wishlist if you haven’t done so already. Thank you all for your feedback and support, and see you soon for the demo!

notes.title: Update 0.1.1-alpha | Added a second boss
notes.content:
➡️ Add to wishlist ❤️

Main updates:
[olist]
 Second boss finalized: With its group of birds that will try to chase you out of the room! Beware of those pesky birds!  
 Quest harvest fixes: Issues related to resource collection and quest validation have been fixed. (It was just a visual bug, but it’s resolved now.)
[/olist]

Sound improvements:
[olist]
 Added sounds for quests: You can now hear a sound effect and see an animation when you claim your quest or crafting rewards.  
 Sound for the skull (head): An immersive sound effect has been added when you interact with this item. (I won’t say more, it’s a little secret… heeheehee!)
[/olist]

UI:
[olist]
 Reward visualization: A UI animation is now present when you receive your items upon completing a quest or a craft.
[/olist]

Some images from the update: 

Image 1  
Just before the boss realizes I'm here.  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41820683/7bdd9e58d0312df76de21ef06d5de4390d721c9f.png

Image 2

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41820683/01f8a17c5f3a86778a27b020cc6a61ba65a19093.png

Image 3  
Now that it’s on, good luck dodging those pesky birds!  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41820683/52e150e75060d3afecf6e90c0bdbb9bc21ffc05a.png

Image 4  
You’ll be surprised once or twice. Try to get into the rhythm, the boss is predictable: it always follows the same routine 😉  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41820683/e37b93caef488391bd543da48dbf8145d85fde82.png

Image 5  
How cute… They are surrounding you...  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41820683/9fb530fc990029c7d09e7c8fc92a8385358b33a2.png

To the lucky ones who pass the test: beautiful little rewards are waiting for you, along with a direct exit door to save all this great loot and be able to craft beautiful items ❤️  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41820683/a5b2660cdeb48124708441b9bfa036599f19cf7d.png

Get ready, when the demo arrives, you might cross paths with it in the rocky dungeon!  
Thanks again for your support and feedback ❤️

notes.title: TileHunter comes back to life in 2025 !
notes.content:
After a long break, we are pleased to announce that the development of TileHunter is back on track. 

Thank you for your continued support ❤️ 
We have worked hard to make the game nearly playable and we can't wait to share a demo with you very soon.

➡️ Add to wishlist ❤️

Here are some screenshots of the current game: 

image 1 
Here, we can see a room in the rocky dungeon in v0.1.0-alpha version, with two monsters, some resources, and even a rain of large drops that, if you pass through, will take care of you. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41820683/1f589464db82891abf5a6b1a736dfadcac0aeb7a.png

image 2 
Here, we can see the current interface of the inventory part, with the player, the equipment section, the inventory section, and the craft section, which currently offers two crafts for two equippable items. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41820683/85d8119f05c86e644427bc7ee9efca13b1b74dcd.png

image 3 
The map and the progress bar indicate where you are and your position in relation to the different types of floors. At levels 5 and 10, you will find the bosses and the exit door. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41820683/75dcc3a82f181c9bbf306c06d47fc7cc9f970f73.png

image 4 
The room before the drama, when the boss is waiting for you... ahahahahah ! {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41820683/0cad9cc9520b3196bcae891ac3ac75c23d62fa8d.png

image 5 
Here, we can observe a fight between a player and boss number 1. Bombs are falling from the sky and must be broken by the player. If the player fails in time, the bomb will explode, and they will lose health until death. 3 waves, hang in there! {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41820683/7fd9feb6ccca72a65754ab0167117405af6aa40e.png
